title: Sustainable Agriculture Defined & Practices Explained
reason: Describes various sustainable agricultural practices and their benefits.

tasks.task: Explain the definition of sustainable agriculture and its components.

subtasks.text: Define sustainable agriculture and mention it includes economic, social, and environmental aspects.
Explain environmental sustainability in agriculture involves good stewardship, building and maintaining healthy soil, managing water, and promoting biodiversity.

tasks.task: Discuss the relationship between organic farming and sustainable agriculture.

subtasks.text: Contrast organic and sustainable agriculture, noting organic standards have room for non-optimally sustainable practices.
Mention that not all sustainable farmers pursue USDA organic certification.

tasks.task: Present examples of sustainable agricultural practices.

subtasks.text: Describe crop rotation and its benefits in creating healthier soil and improving pest control.
Explain inner cropping and multi-year crop rotations as common crop strategies.
Describe the benefits of planting cover crops to protect and build soil health.
Explain the practice of reduced tilling and its benefits in reducing erosion and improving soil health.
Describe integrated pest management (IPM) and its goal of minimizing pesticide use.
Mention the benefits of agroforestry in providing shade and shelter to protect various farm elements.
